stories.label: Iran war Day 18: Trump denies school bombing; UNSC passes Bahrain resolution; Oslo embassy attack
stories.summary: Day 18. Trump claims to be 'unaware of evidence' the US bombed the Resalat girls' school (148 children killed). UNSC passed a Bahrain-drafted resolution demanding Iran halt Gulf attacks — first formal UN action, though silent on original US-Israel strikes. The Oslo US Embassy was bombed by three brothers of Iraqi origin in the first Iran-war-linked terror attack on Western soil. Gulf migrant workers remain trapped by the kafala system with no evacuation rights. The war has now crossed into European domestic security.

stories.label: Hormuz economic fallout: IEA mobilises one-third reserves; India/US oil pivot; Sweden growth cut
stories.summary: IEA activated one-third of all member-state strategic reserves — near-total mobilisation of the emergency system. Trump announced Reliance Industries (India's largest refiner) backing a new US oil refinery, signalling a US-India post-Hormuz energy architecture. Sweden became the first European government to formally cut its GDP forecast (to 2.8%) due to the war. South African insurer OUTsurance disclosed simultaneous war risk and climate risk on their balance sheet — two crises converging.

stories.label: BRICS divided: Iran and UAE at war within the bloc — Global South fracture
stories.summary: Iran (founding member) and UAE (joined Jan 2024) are now at war within BRICS. The bloc cannot take a unified position. China and Russia protecting Iran diplomatically; Gulf states aligned with US. Saudi Arabia's pending BRICS membership application is now the live geopolitical tripwire within the bloc.

stories.label: Oslo US Embassy bombing — first Iran-war-linked terror attack on Western soil
stories.summary: Three brothers of Iraqi origin arrested for 'terrorist bombing' of the US Embassy compound in Oslo — the first confirmed Iran-war-linked terror attack on Western soil. War has crossed into European domestic security. Day 18 of conflict. Norwegian police investigating ideological motive.

stories.label: UNSC adopts Bahrain resolution demanding Iran halt Gulf attacks — first UN action
stories.summary: UNSC passed Bahrain-drafted resolution condemning Iran's attacks on Gulf states and demanding immediate cessation. First formal UN action after 18 days of war. Resolution is silent on original US-Israel strikes that triggered the conflict. Vote alignment (Russia/China abstain vs. veto?) reveals diplomatic architecture.

stories.label: Google acquires Wiz ($32B) — largest acquisition in Google history, Unit 8200 founders
stories.summary: Google closed acquisition of Wiz, cloud security firm founded by Unit 8200 (Israeli military intelligence) alumni, for ~$32B — Google's largest acquisition. Wiz secures cloud workloads for most Fortune 500 companies. Closed during active US-Israel-Iran war in which cybersecurity has been a central battlefield. Congressional and EU scrutiny expected.

stories.label: ISA seabed-mining treaty negotiations — environmental governance for deep-ocean cobalt extraction
stories.summary: ISA negotiating whether to permit industrial mining of deep-sea polymetallic nodules (cobalt, nickel, manganese for EV batteries) at cost of permanently destroying ancient ocean-floor ecosystems. Proponents: The Metals Company, Norway, China. Moratorium advocates: France, Chile, most marine scientists. The energy transition's ethical contradiction: 'green' minerals from permanent destruction.

stories.label: Australia record hot summers + Cape Town 40°C+ heatwave — Southern Hemisphere climate signal
stories.summary: Two simultaneous climate stories: Australian temperature station data shows measurably hotter summers across generations; Cape Town in day 3 of severe heatwave exceeding 40°C in early March (when autumn should be arriving). Both are consistent with climate model projections for the Southern Hemisphere. Covered with two articles this cycle.

stories.label: Singapore lowest fertility rate despite maximum state intervention — limits of technocratic governance
stories.summary: Singapore recorded its lowest-ever fertility rate despite deploying AI dating apps, subsidised fertility clinics, $10,000+ baby bonuses, and mandatory parenting courses. The experiment reveals the limit of technocratic social engineering: structural forces (housing costs, workplace gender inequality, economic logic of DINK households) resist algorithmic intervention. Japan, South Korea, China watching and failing similarly.

stories.label: Bellingcat Turnstone: open-source flight tracking tool launched during Gulf airspace war
stories.summary: Bellingcat released Turnstone, an open-source historical and spatial flight data tool, as airspace over the Gulf has been contested daily. Previously required expensive commercial subscriptions. Enables public verification of military flight paths, airspace violations, and ADS-B data. Immediately relevant to B-2 intercept claims, F-35 sorties over Lebanon, and P-8 reconnaissance.

stories.label: Lebanon: 700K+ displaced; France UNSC resolution outcome unknown
stories.summary: 700K+ displaced; 394 killed in one week including 83 children; white phosphorus in populated areas (HRW confirmed). Lebanon delayed elections two years. France's UNSC emergency session outcome unknown — now potentially superseded by the Bahrain-led resolution passed today. Not selected this cycle.

stories.label: Israel privately admits no certainty Iran government will fall despite war
stories.summary: Reuters obtained internal Israeli acknowledgment that there is 'no certainty' the war will produce regime change in Iran. Mojtaba Khamenei consolidating rather than fracturing. War's stated justification privately conceded as potentially failing — while thousands die.

stories.label: Spain removes ambassador to Israel — first EU/NATO diplomatic downgrade
stories.summary: Spain formally removed its ambassador to Israel, published in official state gazette. First EU/NATO state to downgrade diplomatic relations. Watch for Belgium, Ireland, or France following — any second EU state becomes a coalition fracture story.

stories.label: Anti-Muslim hate arc: platform amplification → UK media bias study → CAIR → state protest ban
stories.summary: Five-part arc from algorithmic amplification to state suppression. Al-Quds Day march banned by UK Home Secretary. Watch for legal challenge to ban, advertiser pressure on platforms, Congressional discipline for US lawmaker. Not selected this cycle.

stories.label: AI in warfare: China names 'Terminator' risk; disinformation; autonomous failures
stories.summary: China's 'Terminator' warning was the last addition. Google acquiring Wiz (Unit 8200 founders) adds a new dimension: civilian tech infrastructure now integrated with military intelligence lineage. Watch for UN response to autonomous weapons risk, and EU AI Act enforcement during wartime.

stories.label: Rheinmetall calls war an 'opportunity' — defence industry boom
stories.summary: Rheinmetall publicly called the war a 'business opportunity.' Watch for other contractors (BAE Systems, Leonardo, Thales) making similar declarations and for EU parliamentary scrutiny.

stories.label: Record 155 Russian billionaires on Forbes list — sanctions empirically failed
stories.summary: 155 Russian billionaires on Forbes list — record, fourth consecutive growth year. Sanctions-as-pressure-on-elites theory has empirically failed. Wealth held in UAE, Turkey, China — beyond Western reach.

stories.label: China five-year climate goals: Paris compatibility analysis
stories.summary: Carbon Brief verified China's five-year plan targets against Paris goals. Arc: announcement → scientific verification → policy consequences. Watch for next step: other nations' official responses.

stories.label: Chinese firm claims B-2 stealth bomber signal intercepted during Iran strike
stories.summary: Jingan Technology (PLA intelligence contractor) claims B-2 Spirit signal intercepted March 1. If genuine, changes Taiwan Strait and Korean peninsula calculations. Bellingcat's Turnstone tool (selected this cycle) is now potentially applicable to retrospective verification. Watch for US DoD response.

stories.label: Darfur: RSF destroys farms before mass killings — starvation crimes evidence
stories.summary: Forensic evidence of RSF destroying farms before mass killings. Not in feed for two consecutive cycles. AllAfrica and Premium Times not surfacing hard news. The crisis continues regardless of our feed gaps.

stories.label: Chile: Kast inaugurated; Lula boycott; Machado-Milei-Kast right bloc
stories.summary: Kast inaugurated. Kast-Milei-Machado axis forming. Decayed from 5. Watch for first migration crackdowns and trade positions.

stories.label: Hajj 2026: War continues as pilgrimage season (late May) approaches
stories.summary: Indonesia (world's largest Hajj delegation) formally preparing contingencies. 1.8 billion Muslims' sacred obligation is now a logistics question. Hajj begins late May — window narrowing. Next key signal: Saudi Arabia's own public statement.

stories.label: UK coal at 400-year low; emissions fall 2.4% — pre-industrial energy milestone
stories.summary: UK coal consumption at lowest level in 400 years. Covered last cycle. Watch for similar milestones from Germany and France as the clean energy transition continues under war media blackout.

stories.label: Mastercard + 85 partners building blockchain payment infrastructure
stories.summary: Mastercard assembled 85+ partners connecting on-chain payments with banking infrastructure. Who loses: correspondent banks, SWIFT. Watch for regulatory response and adoption metrics.

stories.label: Yann LeCun raises $1B to build world-model AI — scientific challenge to LLM paradigm
stories.summary: LeCun raising $1B for AI that learns physical world models, arguing LLMs cannot achieve general intelligence. Watch for funding confirmation and first technical publications.

stories.label: UK Home Secretary bans Al-Quds Day march; civil liberties under wartime state
stories.summary: Shabana Mahmood approved ban on 40-year-old pro-Palestine march. Watch for legal challenge and whether other European states follow. Part of anti-Muslim-hate arc.

stories.label: Trump reportedly plans to seize Iran's Kharg Island oil terminal
stories.summary: No State Dept or NSC confirmation. Not covered two consecutive cycles — fading.

stories.label: US commanders told troops Trump 'anointed by Jesus'; Democrats demand investigation
stories.summary: Investigation demanded. Not covered two cycles — fading.

stories.label: Ukraine: Turkey trilateral peace process stalled
stories.summary: Five consecutive cycles uncovered. Iran war has completely dominated coverage. Keeping as reminder — the frontline continues regardless.

stories.label: Gaza: Siege continues — total media blackout now 10+ cycles
stories.summary: WHO warned medical supplies exhausted. No feed items 10+ cycles. Total blackout under Iran war coverage. Cannot be pruned — the silence is the story.
